description: Record or remove a pipe entry in .flurryport/pipes.json, upserting by name, so the wiring survives restarts and travels with the repo. NEVER put a key or token value in any field: a signing key is referenced by localKeyRef only, and the write is refused if anything token-shaped appears. Mark draft true while wiring, and clear it once the pipe is verified.

draft.description: true while the pipe is being wired / not yet verified.

endpointSlug.description: Endpoint slug the pipe rides on.

intentSchema.description: JSON schema (or informal shape) of the intent payload post_intent callers author.

name.description: Pipe name - the upsert key within the manifest.

projectId.description: Opaque project id; omit to use the claimed or only project.

recipe.description: Catalog recipe ref (publisher:slug@version), when installed from one.

remove.description: true = delete the named entry instead of upserting.

signingKeyRef.description: Keystore ref from set_endpoint_signing (e.g. "signing:<endpointId>") - a NAME, never a value.

name: write_pipe_manifest
title: Write pipe manifest
